entries.keywords: Rp / IDR / USD Indonesian rupiah / international IDR currency code / US dollars; never add money figures with incompatible currencies or bases. Rupiah / kode mata uang rupiah / dolar AS; jangan jumlahkan angka dengan mata uang dan dasar pelaporan berbeda.

entries.title: Rp/kWh

entries.keywords: SAIDI / SAIFI System Average Interruption Duration / Frequency Index, electricity reliability indicators. Indeks rata-rata durasi / frekuensi gangguan layanan listrik.

entries.title: Sakernas
entries.description: SLI glossary · Indonesia's National Labor Force Survey administered by BPS.
entries.keywords: Sakernas Indonesia's National Labor Force Survey administered by BPS. Survei Angkatan Kerja Nasional yang dilaksanakan BPS.

entries.title: Sector vs asset type vs source registry
entries.description: SLI glossary · Sector: industry family. Asset type: a facility/contract/technology within it. Source registry: originating dataset, NOT an industry sector. Each row belongs to exactly one pu
entries.keywords: Sector vs asset type vs source registry Sector: industry family. Asset type: a facility/contract/technology within it. Source registry: originating dataset, NOT an industry sector. Each row belongs to exactly one public-facing sector/type but can overlap another parent record. Sektor: kelompok industri. Jenis aset: fasilitas, kontrak atau teknologi dalam sektor tersebut. Registri sumber: asal dataset, BUKAN nama sektor. Setiap entri hanya satu sektor/jenis aset pada tampilan, namun dapat merujuk aset induk yang sama.

entries.title: SKK Migas
entries.description: SLI glossary · Special Task Force for Upstream Oil and Gas Business Activities.
entries.keywords: SKK Migas Special Task Force for Upstream Oil and Gas Business Activities. Satuan Kerja Khusus Pelaksana Kegiatan Usaha Hulu Minyak dan Gas Bumi.

entries.title: Smelter
entries.description: SLI glossary · A metallurgical facility converting ores/concentrates into metal, alloy or intermediate products using thermal/electrochemical processing.
entries.keywords: Smelter A metallurgical facility converting ores/concentrates into metal, alloy or intermediate products using thermal/electrochemical processing. Fasilitas metalurgi yang mengolah bijih/konsentrat menjadi logam, paduan atau produk antara melalui proses termal/elektrokimia.

entries.title: Smelter & Metal Refining
entries.description: SLI glossary · Metallurgical processing or purification of ores/metals. Includes smelting, nickel processing, and alumina refining; specific processes differ.
entries.keywords: Smelter & Metal Refining Metallurgical processing or purification of ores/metals. Includes smelting, nickel processing, and alumina refining; specific processes differ. Pengolahan/pemurnian bijih atau logam: mencakup peleburan, pengolahan nikel, dan kilang alumina. Proses tiap fasilitas berbeda.

entries.title: Smelter vs refinery / processing
entries.description: SLI glossary · Metal smelters/refineries process mineral ore/intermediate products into metal; an oil refinery processes petroleum. 'Processing' is a process, not an additional stand-alone m
entries.keywords: Smelter vs refinery / processing Metal smelters/refineries process mineral ore/intermediate products into metal; an oil refinery processes petroleum. 'Processing' is a process, not an additional stand-alone map sector. Smelter/pemurnian logam mengolah bijih/produk antara menjadi logam; kilang minyak mengolah minyak bumi. 'Processing' adalah kegiatan, bukan sektor baru terpisah.

entries.title: Source monitor vs editor review
entries.description: SLI glossary · Discovery of new publisher text versus substantive validation before publishing numbers.
entries.keywords: Source monitor vs editor review Discovery of new publisher text versus substantive validation before publishing numbers. Penemuan sumber/berita baru dibanding verifikasi substansi sebelum angka diterbitkan.

entries.title: Source provenance
entries.description: SLI glossary · Issuer, original URL, vintage, measurement units, denominator and validation status for each statistic.
entries.keywords: Source provenance Issuer, original URL, vintage, measurement units, denominator and validation status for each statistic. Jejak sumber: penerbit, URL asli, edisi, satuan, penyebut, dan status verifikasi.

entries.title: SPBKLU
entries.description: SLI glossary · Public Electric Vehicle Battery Swapping Station.
entries.keywords: SPBKLU Public Electric Vehicle Battery Swapping Station. Stasiun Penukaran Baterai Kendaraan Listrik Umum.

entries.title: SPKLU
entries.description: SLI glossary · Public Electric Vehicle Charging Station.
entries.keywords: SPKLU Public Electric Vehicle Charging Station. Stasiun Pengisian Kendaraan Listrik Umum.

entries.title: SRUT
entries.description: SLI glossary · Type Test Registration Certificate for motor vehicles.
entries.keywords: SRUT Type Test Registration Certificate for motor vehicles. Sertifikat Registrasi Uji Tipe kendaraan bermotor.

entries.title: SWOT / PESTEL
entries.description: SLI glossary · Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats / Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Environmental, Legal.
entries.keywords: SWOT / PESTEL Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats / Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Environmental, Legal. Analisis kekuatan, kelemahan, peluang, ancaman / dimensi politik, ekonomi, sosial, teknologi, lingkungan, hukum.

entries.title: Tcf
entries.description: SLI glossary · Trillion cubic feet of gas volume; a resource/reserves volume, not daily production.
entries.keywords: Tcf Trillion cubic feet of gas volume; a resource/reserves volume, not daily production. Triliun kaki kubik volume gas; ukuran sumber daya/cadangan, bukan produksi harian.

entries.title: tCO₂ / tCO₂e
entries.description: SLI glossary · Metric tonnes of carbon dioxide / tonnes of CO₂-equivalent.
entries.keywords: tCO₂ / tCO₂e Metric tonnes of carbon dioxide / tonnes of CO₂-equivalent. Ton metrik CO₂ / ton setara CO₂.

entries.title: TKDN
entries.description: SLI glossary · Domestic Component Level (local content).
entries.keywords: TKDN Domestic Component Level (local content). Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri.

entries.title: TPT / Unemployment
entries.description: SLI glossary · Open unemployment rate as a share of the labor force under the specified statistical definition.
entries.keywords: TPT / Unemployment Open unemployment rate as a share of the labor force under the specified statistical definition. Tingkat Pengangguran Terbuka sebagai persentase angkatan kerja sesuai definisi survei.

entries.title: TRIMs / SCM / GATS
entries.description: SLI glossary · WTO trade-related investment measures / subsidies and countervailing measures / services agreements.
entries.keywords: TRIMs / SCM / GATS WTO trade-related investment measures / subsidies and countervailing measures / services agreements. Perjanjian WTO tentang investasi terkait perdagangan / subsidi dan bea imbalan / perdagangan jasa.

entries.title: TSCF
entries.description: SLI glossary · Trillion Standard Cubic Feet.
entries.keywords: TSCF Trillion Standard Cubic Feet. Triliun kaki kubik standar.

entries.title: US$/bbl
entries.description: SLI glossary · US dollars per barrel.
entries.keywords: US$/bbl US dollars per barrel. Dolar AS per barel.

entries.title: US$bn / Rp tn
entries.description: SLI glossary · Billion US dollars / trillion Indonesian rupiah.
entries.keywords: US$bn / Rp tn Billion US dollars / trillion Indonesian rupiah. Miliar dolar AS / triliun rupiah.

entries.title: USD / IDR
entries.description: SLI glossary · Rupiah units required for one US dollar; higher USD/IDR indicates weaker rupiah.
entries.keywords: USD / IDR Rupiah units required for one US dollar; higher USD/IDR indicates weaker rupiah. Jumlah rupiah untuk satu dolar AS; kenaikan USD/IDR menandakan rupiah melemah.

entries.title: UUD / UU / Perppu
entries.description: SLI glossary · Constitution / statute / government regulation in lieu of law.
entries.keywords: UUD / UU / Perppu Constitution / statute / government regulation in lieu of law. Undang-Undang Dasar / Undang-Undang / Peraturan Pemerintah Pengganti Undang-Undang.

entries.title: WDI
entries.description: SLI glossary · World Development Indicators, the World Bank's standardized indicator series.
entries.keywords: WDI World Development Indicators, the World Bank's standardized indicator series. World Development Indicators, seri indikator terstandar dari Bank Dunia.

entries.title: WGS84
entries.description: SLI glossary · Global latitude/longitude reference system; a district/city anchor is not a surveyed facility coordinate.
entries.keywords: WGS84 Global latitude/longitude reference system; a district/city anchor is not a surveyed facility coordinate. Sistem referensi lintang/bujur global; titik kota/kabupaten bukan koordinat survei fasilitas.

entries.title: WGS84 / coordinates
entries.description: SLI glossary · Global geographic coordinate reference system commonly used for longitude/latitude.
entries.keywords: WGS84 / coordinates Global geographic coordinate reference system commonly used for longitude/latitude. Sistem koordinat geografis global untuk lintang/bujur.

entries.title: WK
entries.description: SLI glossary · Working Area: a government-designated exploration/production contract area; one WK can contain several fields.
entries.keywords: WK Working Area: a government-designated exploration/production contract area; one WK can contain several fields. Wilayah Kerja: area kontrak eksplorasi/produksi migas; satu WK dapat memiliki beberapa lapangan.

entries.title: WK / PSC & Upstream Fields
entries.description: SLI glossary · Exploration / production contract area or oil/gas field; not a refining facility.
entries.keywords: WK / PSC & Upstream Fields Exploration / production contract area or oil/gas field; not a refining facility. Wilayah kontrak atau lapangan produksi migas; bukan fasilitas pengilangan.

entries.title: WTO / GATT / DSU
entries.description: SLI glossary · World Trade Organization / GATT goods trade disciplines / Dispute Settlement Understanding.
entries.keywords: WTO / GATT / DSU World Trade Organization / GATT goods trade disciplines / Dispute Settlement Understanding. Organisasi Perdagangan Dunia / aturan perdagangan barang GATT / prosedur sengketa DSU.

entries.title: YoY / MoM / QoQ
entries.description: SLI glossary · Change against same period last year / prior month / previous quarter.
entries.keywords: YoY / MoM / QoQ Change against same period last year / prior month / previous quarter. Perubahan terhadap periode sama tahun lalu / bulan sebelumnya / triwulan sebelumnya.

entries.title: Stress testing
entries.description: SLI glossary · Testing an investment under explicitly assumed adverse conditions; not a probability forecast.
entries.keywords: Stress testing Testing an investment under explicitly assumed adverse conditions; not a probability forecast. Menguji investasi dengan kondisi buruk berdasarkan asumsi eksplisit; bukan ramalan probabilitas.

entries.title: Breaking point
entries.description: SLI glossary · A defined threshold where a chosen business outcome (such as operating surplus) reaches zero. Not necessarily insolvency.
entries.keywords: Breaking point A defined threshold where a chosen business outcome (such as operating surplus) reaches zero. Not necessarily insolvency. Ambang ketika hasil usaha terpilih (misalnya surplus operasi) mencapai nol; bukan berarti otomatis bangkrut.

entries.title: Operating surplus
entries.description: SLI glossary · Revenue minus the operating costs represented in a simplified model, before omitted financing, taxes or depreciation.
entries.keywords: Operating surplus Revenue minus the operating costs represented in a simplified model, before omitted financing, taxes or depreciation. Pendapatan dikurangi biaya operasi yang tercakup dalam model sederhana; belum memperhitungkan pembiayaan, pajak, atau depresiasi yang tidak dimodelkan.

entries.title: Break-even electricity tariff
entries.description: SLI glossary · Implied electricity price at which modeled data-center operating surplus is zero given fixed utilization and assumptions.
entries.keywords: Break-even electricity tariff Implied electricity price at which modeled data-center operating surplus is zero given fixed utilization and assumptions. Tarif listrik tersirat yang menjadikan surplus operasi pusat data nol dengan utilisasi dan asumsi tetap.

entries.title: Power rationing
entries.description: SLI glossary · An assumed fraction of electricity availability curtailed; the lab simplifies lost availability as proportional lost service revenue.
entries.keywords: Power rationing An assumed fraction of electricity availability curtailed; the lab simplifies lost availability as proportional lost service revenue. Pembatasan pasokan listrik yang diasumsikan; lab menyederhanakan kehilangan pasokan sebagai penurunan proporsional pendapatan layanan.

entries.title: Power usage effectiveness (PUE)
entries.description: SLI glossary · Facility electricity consumption divided by IT-equipment electricity consumption; unitless and at least 1 in a valid model.
entries.keywords: Power usage effectiveness (PUE) Facility electricity consumption divided by IT-equipment electricity consumption; unitless and at least 1 in a valid model. Konsumsi listrik fasilitas dibagi konsumsi listrik perangkat IT; tanpa satuan dan minimal 1 dalam model valid.

entries.title: Inventory survival runway
entries.description: SLI glossary · Estimated stock coverage expressed in weeks assuming unchanged consumption and no replenishment.
entries.keywords: Inventory survival runway Estimated stock coverage expressed in weeks assuming unchanged consumption and no replenishment. Perkiraan lama stok mencukupi dalam minggu dengan asumsi pemakaian konstan tanpa pasokan ulang.

entries.title: Uncovered supply-gap duration
entries.description: SLI glossary · Maximum of zero and delayed supply days minus days of usable buffer inventory.
entries.keywords: Uncovered supply-gap duration Maximum of zero and delayed supply days minus days of usable buffer inventory. Maksimum nol dan selisih hari keterlambatan pasokan dengan hari persediaan cadangan yang dapat digunakan.

entries.title: Cost pass-through
entries.description: SLI glossary · Assumed share of additional input/logistics costs recovered through sales pricing; it does not itself estimate demand elasticity.
entries.keywords: Cost pass-through Assumed share of additional input/logistics costs recovered through sales pricing; it does not itself estimate demand elasticity. Porsi asumsi tambahan biaya bahan baku/logistik yang dapat dibebankan ke harga jual; bukan estimasi elastisitas permintaan.

entries.title: Demand destruction
entries.description: SLI glossary · Reduction in sales volume due to shocks; in the lab it is an independent user-defined percentage, not statistically inferred.
entries.keywords: Demand destruction Reduction in sales volume due to shocks; in the lab it is an independent user-defined percentage, not statistically inferred. Penurunan volume penjualan akibat guncangan; di lab merupakan persentase asumsi pengguna, bukan hasil estimasi statistik.

entries.title: Oil–FX double shock
entries.description: SLI glossary · Combined effect of a changed USD oil price and changed IDR per USD on local-currency oil-import cost.
entries.keywords: Oil–FX double shock Combined effect of a changed USD oil price and changed IDR per USD on local-currency oil-import cost. Pengaruh gabungan perubahan harga minyak dalam USD dan kurs IDR per USD terhadap biaya impor minyak dalam rupiah.

entries.title: Fiscal pass-through sensitivity
entries.description: SLI glossary · User-selected fraction of an incremental import bill treated as possible fiscal exposure; not an official subsidy estimate.
entries.keywords: Fiscal pass-through sensitivity User-selected fraction of an incremental import bill treated as possible fiscal exposure; not an official subsidy estimate. Bagian asumsi kenaikan biaya impor yang dianggap sebagai potensi eksposur fiskal; bukan estimasi subsidi resmi.

entries.title: Gini ratio (expenditure)
entries.description: SLI glossary · A 0–1 coefficient measuring inequality in the distribution of household expenditure in the stated population and survey, not income or wealth.
entries.keywords: Gini ratio (expenditure) A 0–1 coefficient measuring inequality in the distribution of household expenditure in the stated population and survey, not income or wealth. Koefisien 0–1 yang mengukur ketimpangan pengeluaran rumah tangga pada populasi dan survei tertentu, bukan pendapatan atau kekayaan.

entries.title: Provincial Gini vs national Gini
entries.description: SLI glossary · A province's survey coefficient and the national population coefficient are separate statistics; national Gini is not the arithmetic mean of provincial Gini.
entries.keywords: Provincial Gini vs national Gini A province's survey coefficient and the national population coefficient are separate statistics; national Gini is not the arithmetic mean of provincial Gini. Koefisien ketimpangan provinsi dan nasional berasal dari populasi berbeda; Gini nasional bukan rata-rata sederhana Gini provinsi.

entries.title: Regional Gini median (SLI)
entries.description: SLI glossary · The median of province-level Gini coefficients within an editorial geographic grouping; it is not a pooled regional-population Gini.
entries.keywords: Regional Gini median (SLI) The median of province-level Gini coefficients within an editorial geographic grouping; it is not a pooled regional-population Gini. Median koefisien Gini antarprovinsi dalam kelompok wilayah editorial; bukan Gini populasi wilayah gabungan.

entries.title: GRDP / PDRB
entries.description: SLI glossary · Gross regional domestic product: added value of goods and services produced within a province; nominal and constant-price measures have different meanings.
entries.keywords: GRDP / PDRB Gross regional domestic product: added value of goods and services produced within a province; nominal and constant-price measures have different meanings. Produk domestik regional bruto: nilai tambah barang dan jasa di provinsi; nilai berlaku dan harga konstan tidak sama.

entries.title: PMTB / Gross fixed capital formation
entries.description: SLI glossary · Expenditure on fixed assets used in production, part of expenditure-account GDP/GRDP; not synonymous with realized BKPM investment.
entries.keywords: PMTB / Gross fixed capital formation Expenditure on fixed assets used in production, part of expenditure-account GDP/GRDP; not synonymous with realized BKPM investment. Pembentukan Modal Tetap Bruto: pengeluaran untuk aset tetap produksi dalam PDB/PDRB, bukan sinonim realisasi investasi BKPM.

entries.title: Real GRDP growth
entries.description: SLI glossary · Percentage change in consistently measured constant-price regional output for a defined period; not identical to growth in nominal rupiah.
entries.keywords: Real GRDP growth Percentage change in consistently measured constant-price regional output for a defined period; not identical to growth in nominal rupiah. Persentase perubahan output daerah pada harga konstan dan periode yang konsisten; berbeda dari pertumbuhan rupiah nominal.

entries.title: Cross-sectional correlation
entries.description: SLI glossary · A descriptive association across observation units (such as provinces), which alone neither proves causality nor accounts for omitted determinants.
entries.keywords: Cross-sectional correlation A descriptive association across observation units (such as provinces), which alone neither proves causality nor accounts for omitted determinants. Hubungan deskriptif antarunit (misalnya provinsi), yang tidak dengan sendirinya membuktikan sebab-akibat atau mengatasi faktor yang diabaikan.

entries.title: Panel data
entries.description: SLI glossary · Observations of the same units over multiple periods; comparability, missing years, fixed effects and lag structure affect valid conclusions.
entries.keywords: Panel data Observations of the same units over multiple periods; comparability, missing years, fixed effects and lag structure affect valid conclusions. Pengamatan unit yang sama pada beberapa periode; kesebandingan, tahun kosong, efek tetap dan jeda variabel memengaruhi kesimpulan.

entries.title: Province fixed effects
entries.description: SLI glossary · A panel-data specification controlling for time-invariant unobserved characteristics of each province; it does not eliminate time-varying confounding.
entries.keywords: Province fixed effects A panel-data specification controlling for time-invariant unobserved characteristics of each province; it does not eliminate time-varying confounding. Spesifikasi data panel yang mengendalikan karakteristik provinsi yang tidak berubah sepanjang waktu; tidak menghilangkan perancu yang berubah.

entries.title: Within R-squared
entries.description: SLI glossary · Share of within-unit outcome variation described by a fixed-effects specification in its estimation sample; not a causal proof or forecast score.
entries.keywords: Within R-squared Share of within-unit outcome variation described by a fixed-effects specification in its estimation sample; not a causal proof or forecast score. Proporsi variasi dalam-unit yang dijelaskan model efek tetap pada sampel estimasi; bukan bukti kausal atau mutu prakiraan.

entries.title: Lagged explanatory variable
entries.description: SLI glossary · An input measured in an earlier period than the dependent variable; a lag alone does not establish causal identification.
entries.keywords: Lagged explanatory variable An input measured in an earlier period than the dependent variable; a lag alone does not establish causal identification. Variabel penjelas yang diukur sebelum periode variabel hasil; jeda waktu saja bukan identifikasi kausal.

entries.title: Regression coefficient
entries.description: SLI glossary · A model-estimated association expressed in specified units, conditional on the equation, sample and controls; it is not automatically an economic multiplier.
entries.keywords: Regression coefficient A model-estimated association expressed in specified units, conditional on the equation, sample and controls; it is not automatically an economic multiplier. Asosiasi hasil estimasi model dengan satuan tertentu, tergantung persamaan, sampel dan variabel kendali; bukan otomatis pengganda ekonomi.

entries.title: Statistical confidence interval
entries.description: SLI glossary · A range produced by a statistical procedure with stated coverage assumptions; it does not repair bias or poor measurement.
entries.keywords: Statistical confidence interval A range produced by a statistical procedure with stated coverage assumptions; it does not repair bias or poor measurement. Rentang hasil prosedur statistik dengan asumsi cakupan tertentu; tidak memperbaiki bias atau pengukuran yang buruk.

entries.title: Causal inference
entries.description: SLI glossary · Inference about changes due to an intervention, requiring an identification strategy beyond a simple correlation or fitted regression.
entries.keywords: Causal inference Inference about changes due to an intervention, requiring an identification strategy beyond a simple correlation or fitted regression. Penarikan kesimpulan dampak suatu intervensi yang memerlukan strategi identifikasi, bukan sekadar korelasi atau regresi.

entries.title: Omitted variable bias
entries.description: SLI glossary · Distortion of a model coefficient when an unobserved relevant factor is associated with both the explanatory variable and the outcome.
entries.keywords: Omitted variable bias Distortion of a model coefficient when an unobserved relevant factor is associated with both the explanatory variable and the outcome. Penyimpangan koefisien akibat faktor relevan yang tidak masuk model tetapi berkorelasi dengan variabel penjelas dan hasil.

entries.title: Input-output transactions table
entries.description: SLI glossary · A dated matrix of interindustry purchases and sales that defines sector detail and geographic scope; different matrices cannot be interchanged silently.
entries.keywords: Input-output transactions table A dated matrix of interindustry purchases and sales that defines sector detail and geographic scope; different matrices cannot be interchanged silently. Matriks pembelian dan penjualan antarindustri pada periode, wilayah dan klasifikasi tertentu; tidak boleh ditukar tanpa penyesuaian.

entries.title: Leontief inverse
entries.description: SLI glossary · The matrix (I − A)^−1 in a linear input-output model under fixed technical-coefficient assumptions; use only with a validated A matrix.
entries.keywords: Leontief inverse The matrix (I − A)^−1 in a linear input-output model under fixed technical-coefficient assumptions; use only with a validated A matrix. Matriks (I − A)^−1 pada model input-output linear dengan asumsi koefisien teknis tetap; perlu matriks A tervalidasi.

entries.title: Input-output technical coefficient
entries.description: SLI glossary · An entry in matrix A representing intermediate inputs from one industry per unit of another industry's gross output, for a specified base year.
entries.keywords: Input-output technical coefficient An entry in matrix A representing intermediate inputs from one industry per unit of another industry's gross output, for a specified base year. Elemen matriks A yang menunjukkan input antara sebuah industri per unit output bruto industri lain pada tahun dasar tertentu.

entries.title: Gross-output multiplier
entries.description: SLI glossary · A conditional ratio of total gross-output response to a specified final-demand shock; it is not equivalent to GRDP or employment gains.
entries.keywords: Gross-output multiplier A conditional ratio of total gross-output response to a specified final-demand shock; it is not equivalent to GRDP or employment gains. Rasio respons output bruto total terhadap guncangan permintaan akhir tertentu; bukan kenaikan PDRB atau lapangan kerja.

entries.title: Value-added multiplier
entries.description: SLI glossary · The modelled value-added response to an input or final-demand change; requires sector value-added intensities in a compatible model.
entries.keywords: Value-added multiplier The modelled value-added response to an input or final-demand change; requires sector value-added intensities in a compatible model. Respons nilai tambah hasil model atas perubahan input atau permintaan; memerlukan intensitas nilai tambah sektor yang sebanding.

entries.title: Direct, indirect and induced effects
entries.description: SLI glossary · Direct project or industry activity, interindustry supply-chain responses, and optional household-spending responses; different models may omit induced effects.
entries.keywords: Direct, indirect and induced effects Direct project or industry activity, interindustry supply-chain responses, and optional household-spending responses; different models may omit induced effects. Aktivitas langsung proyek, respons rantai pasok antarsektor, dan respons belanja rumah tangga jika dimodelkan; tidak semua model mencakup pengaruh terinduksi.

entries.title: Imported-input leakage
entries.description: SLI glossary · The portion of spending on imported goods/services that does not generate the same local production response as domestic purchases.
entries.keywords: Imported-input leakage The portion of spending on imported goods/services that does not generate the same local production response as domestic purchases. Bagian belanja pada barang/jasa impor yang tidak menghasilkan respons produksi lokal setara belanja domestik.

entries.title: Counterfactual scenario
entries.description: SLI glossary · An explicitly hypothetical alternative to the observed baseline; not a confirmed outcome, probability or policy impact estimate.
entries.keywords: Counterfactual scenario An explicitly hypothetical alternative to the observed baseline; not a confirmed outcome, probability or policy impact estimate. Alternatif hipotesis terhadap keadaan teramati; bukan hasil pasti, probabilitas atau estimasi dampak kebijakan.

entries.title: Investment opportunity fit score
entries.description: SLI glossary · A transparent weighted screening indicator relative to provinces in the chosen sample; not an official investment ranking or expected financial return.
entries.keywords: Investment opportunity fit score A transparent weighted screening indicator relative to provinces in the chosen sample; not an official investment ranking or expected financial return. Indikator penyaringan berbobot relatif terhadap provinsi dalam sampel; bukan peringkat investasi resmi atau proyeksi imbal hasil.

entries.title: Household electrification ratio
entries.description: SLI glossary · Share of households covered by an explicitly defined electricity-access measure; source year, denominator and access standard must be given.
entries.keywords: Household electrification ratio Share of households covered by an explicitly defined electricity-access measure; source year, denominator and access standard must be given. Persentase rumah tangga yang memenuhi ukuran akses listrik tertentu; perlu tahun sumber, penyebut dan standar akses.

entries.title: Village electrification vs household access
entries.description: SLI glossary · Availability of electricity in a village is a different statistic from the share of its households with electrical connections or reliable service.
entries.keywords: Village electrification vs household access Availability of electricity in a village is a different statistic from the share of its households with electrical connections or reliable service. Desa berlistrik berbeda dari persentase rumah tangga yang tersambung listrik atau menerima layanan andal.

entries.title: Firm grid headroom
entries.description: SLI glossary · Deliverable additional electrical capacity under network and reliability constraints; it cannot be read directly from installed generation or transformer ratings.
entries.keywords: Firm grid headroom Deliverable additional electrical capacity under network and reliability constraints; it cannot be read directly from installed generation or transformer ratings. Tambahan kapasitas listrik yang benar-benar dapat disalurkan dengan batasan jaringan dan keandalan; tidak sama dengan kapasitas pembangkit atau trafo.

entries.title: Electricity capacity factor
entries.description: SLI glossary · Actual energy produced divided by output at full rated power over the same period, with compatible MW and hour definitions.
entries.keywords: Electricity capacity factor Actual energy produced divided by output at full rated power over the same period, with compatible MW and hour definitions. Energi aktual dibagi energi potensial pada daya terpasang penuh untuk periode sama, dengan definisi MW dan jam konsisten.

entries.title: IT load vs facility load
entries.description: SLI glossary · Power drawn by computing equipment differs from total site power, which includes cooling, power conversion and other overhead.
entries.keywords: IT load vs facility load Power drawn by computing equipment differs from total site power, which includes cooling, power conversion and other overhead. Daya perangkat komputasi berbeda dari daya total fasilitas yang juga mencakup pendinginan, konversi listrik dan beban lain.

entries.title: Project registry coverage
entries.description: SLI glossary · A curated list of documented projects that may be incomplete or describe overlapping assets; registry counts are not a census.
entries.keywords: Project registry coverage A curated list of documented projects that may be incomplete or describe overlapping assets; registry counts are not a census. Daftar proyek terdokumentasi yang dapat belum lengkap atau tumpang tindih; jumlah entri bukan sensus aset.

entries.title: Project milestone vs capital realization
entries.description: SLI glossary · Approval, permitting, financing, construction and operation are different stages; none establishes realized expenditure without its own financial evidence.
entries.keywords: Project milestone vs capital realization Approval, permitting, financing, construction and operation are different stages; none establishes realized expenditure without its own financial evidence. Persetujuan, izin, pendanaan, konstruksi dan operasi adalah tahapan berbeda; realisasi belanja memerlukan bukti keuangan tersendiri.

entries.title: FDI realization vs announced commitment
entries.description: SLI glossary · Recorded foreign direct investment realized in the stated accounting system must not be summed with project announcements or prospective financing.
entries.keywords: FDI realization vs announced commitment Recorded foreign direct investment realized in the stated accounting system must not be summed with project announcements or prospective financing. Realisasi PMA dalam sistem pencatatan tertentu tidak boleh dijumlahkan dengan pengumuman proyek atau potensi pembiayaan.

entries.title: Province centroid vs verified coordinate
entries.description: SLI glossary · A province-center locator is an area proxy; a verified facility coordinate is site-specific and must carry its own evidence.
entries.keywords: Province centroid vs verified coordinate A province-center locator is an area proxy; a verified facility coordinate is site-specific and must carry its own evidence. Titik tengah provinsi hanyalah proksi wilayah; koordinat fasilitas yang terverifikasi bersifat spesifik lokasi dan bersumber.

entries.title: Asset duplication and record counting
entries.description: SLI glossary · One facility may occur in multiple project, operator, refinery or power datasets; count distinct assets only after record linkage.
entries.keywords: Asset duplication and record counting One facility may occur in multiple project, operator, refinery or power datasets; count distinct assets only after record linkage. Satu fasilitas dapat muncul dalam dataset proyek, operator, kilang atau pembangkit; hitung aset unik sesudah pencocokan entitas.

entries.title: Source vintage
entries.description: SLI glossary · The original observation's reference period and the publisher's documented edition, distinct from the time it was downloaded.
entries.keywords: Source vintage The original observation's reference period and the publisher's documented edition, distinct from the time it was downloaded. Periode observasi asli dan edisi penerbit, berbeda dari waktu berkas diunduh.

entries.title: Last successful refresh
entries.description: SLI glossary · Timestamp of a completed automated retrieval or build; it does not establish that new facts were published by the original source.
entries.keywords: Last successful refresh Timestamp of a completed automated retrieval or build; it does not establish that new facts were published by the original source. Waktu pengambilan atau kompilasi otomatis yang berhasil; tidak membuktikan sumber primer menerbitkan fakta baru.

entries.title: N/A / unavailable observation
entries.description: SLI glossary · A missing, withheld or unsupported numeric value; it must not be converted to measured zero or silently filled with an estimate.
entries.keywords: N/A / unavailable observation A missing, withheld or unsupported numeric value; it must not be converted to measured zero or silently filled with an estimate. Nilai numerik kosong, tidak tersedia atau tidak didukung sumber; tidak boleh diubah menjadi nol terukur atau estimasi tersembunyi.

entries.title: Search index and record locator
entries.description: SLI glossary · A locally compiled search catalog that leads to a relevant page, section or exact provincial view; it is not full-text search of external sites.
entries.keywords: Search index and record locator A locally compiled search catalog that leads to a relevant page, section or exact provincial view; it is not full-text search of external sites. Katalog pencarian lokal untuk menemukan halaman, bagian atau provinsi tertentu; bukan mesin pencari teks seluruh situs eksternal.

entries.title: Source-linked record
entries.description: SLI glossary · A dashboard entry with an identifiable source file or URL, label and contextual attributes; it may not have its own interactive detail panel.
entries.keywords: Source-linked record A dashboard entry with an identifiable source file or URL, label and contextual attributes; it may not have its own interactive detail panel. Entri dashboard yang mempunyai sumber teridentifikasi, label dan konteks; belum tentu mempunyai panel detail khusus.

entries.title: Publisher release date
entries.description: SLI glossary · Date when the original institution made a finding available, which may be later than the observation period.
entries.keywords: Publisher release date Date when the original institution made a finding available, which may be later than the observation period. Tanggal institusi sumber menerbitkan hasil, yang bisa sesudah periode pengamatan.

entries.title: Official alert vs media lead
entries.description: SLI glossary · Official authority-issued advisories and source-attributed news discovery signals have different verification statuses.
entries.keywords: Official alert vs media lead Official authority-issued advisories and source-attributed news discovery signals have different verification statuses. Peringatan resmi otoritas berbeda tingkat verifikasinya dari informasi awal media yang menyebut sumber.

entries.title: Data reuse and source licence
entries.description: SLI glossary · Permissions, attribution and usage limits of original datasets and images that must be assessed before commercial republication.
entries.keywords: Data reuse and source licence Permissions, attribution and usage limits of original datasets and images that must be assessed before commercial republication. Izin penggunaan ulang, atribusi dan batasan lisensi dataset/gambar sumber yang harus diperiksa sebelum publikasi komersial.

entries.title: Due diligence
entries.description: SLI glossary · Evidence-based examination of project, operator, permits, economics, liabilities and source reliability before a financial or strategic decision.
entries.keywords: Due diligence Evidence-based examination of project, operator, permits, economics, liabilities and source reliability before a financial or strategic decision. Pemeriksaan berbasis bukti terhadap proyek, operator, perizinan, ekonomi, kewajiban dan keandalan sumber sebelum keputusan.
